ADVERTISEMENT FOR THE POST OF JUNIOR RESEARCH FELLOW (JRF)
Applications are invited for the post of one Junior Research Fellow under the Indo-Swiss Joint Research
Project titled “Ice nucleating particles and cloud condensation nuclei properties in the North-Western
Himalayas (ICE-CRUNCH)”. This project presents a unique opportunity to study aerosol properties over
a high-altitude site in Jammu region in collaboration with ETH Zurich, Switzerland. The post will be
filled up purely on contract basis for one year or completion of the project whichever is earlier.
Candidates will have no right to claim any regular appointment.
The details are as follows:
Project Title Ice nucleating particles and cloud condensation
nuclei properties in the North-Western Himalayas
(ICE-CRUNCH)
Funding Agency Ministry of Earth Sciences (MoES)
Position Project JRF
Consolidated Monthly Fellowship Rs. 37000 + 8% HRA
Essential Qualification 1. M.Sc. in Environmental Sciences /
Atmospheric Sciences with a minimum of 55%
marks.
2. NET/GATE Examination Qualified.
Desirable Qualification The candidate having in-depth knowledge of
aerosol measurement techniques and data analysis
using MATLAB, Python or similar software /
languages will be given preference.
Last Date of Application 23.09.2026
How to apply: Interested candidates who fulfill the above conditions may send their application form
along with a CV, academic transcripts, work certificate (if any) and a 1-page motivation letter stating
previous research experience and interests along with contact details through post or e-mail. The
complete application form(on format attached as Annexure I) along with self-attested testimonials
(mentioning post name and reference number on top of the envelope) shall be mailed or sent on the
following e-mail-id/ address:
Dr. Shweta Yadav (Principal Investigator), D-35, Department of Environmental Sciences,
Central University of Jammu, Rahya-Suchani (Bagla), Distt. Samba- 181143, Jammu (J&K),
India, Email: Shweta.evs@cujammu.ac.in, Contact no: 8700244971
General Terms and Conditions:
1. The candidate will be shortlisted for the interview based on merit and will be informed via e-mail.
Mere fulfilling the minimum qualifications will not entitle the candidate for being called for an interview.
The decision of the selection committee will be final in this regard.
2. Candidates shortlisted for interview should appear in person with originals of degree certificates (one
set of self-attested photocopies) and a proof for date of birth (Class 10th Certificate) along with any
other relevant information (e.g. experience certificate, copies of publications if any, awards,
recommendations letters, etc.).
3. The selected individual may be assigned any other duties from time to time commensurate with his/her
qualifications.
4. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview.
5. Central University of Jammu reserves every right to cancel out the process and /or not to fill this
temporary position at any stage of selection process.
For further details, please visit university website www.cujammu.ac.in.
Sd/-
Dr. Shweta Yadav
Principal Investigator
Central University of Jammu
Rahya-Suchani, (Bagla), Distt. Samba
Jammu & Kashmir- 181143
